jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Creative Fabrication & Experiential Production
jobs.description:
**SCPS Unlimited | Torrance, CA | Full-Time | Onsite | Monday–Friday**

**Help Bring Ambitious Creative Projects to Life**

At SCPS Unlimited, we turn imaginative concepts into physical reality. From experiential installations and scenic fabrication to custom props, prototypes, and one-of-a-kind creations, our projects combine creativity, engineering, craftsmanship, and problem-solving.

No two projects are exactly alike, and that's what makes our work exciting.

We're looking for an experienced **Project Coordinator** who understands physical production, enjoys working with creative and technical teams, and knows how to keep multiple moving parts organized.

You'll work closely with Project Managers, Project Leads, designers, fabricators, and vendors to help bring projects from concept through fabrication, delivery, and installation.

**What You'll Do**

* Coordinate and maintain project schedules, production timelines, milestones, and crew assignments using input from Project Managers and Project Leads.
* Track project progress, priorities, approvals, and outstanding action items, proactively identifying potential delays or conflicts.
* Coordinate sourcing, purchasing, and delivery of materials, components, equipment, and services based on project requirements.
* Research vendors, obtain quotes, and support project estimates and purchasing decisions.
* Maintain bills of materials, purchasing records, and project documentation while monitoring costs against approved budgets.
* Coordinate vendors, subcontractors, equipment rentals, freight, shipping, travel, and installation logistics.
* Organize project briefs, drawings, client communications, revisions, and approved changes.
* Support Project Managers with scheduling, meetings, project updates, and client-facing documentation.
* Coordinate project closeout activities, including delivery records, rental returns, final documentation, and outstanding items.
* Anticipate project needs, communicate potential issues early, and help keep teams aligned and moving forward.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience coordinating projects involving **custom fabrication, scenic production, experiential installations, exhibits, themed entertainment, custom manufacturing, or similar physical production environments**.
* Working knowledge of fabrication materials, processes, vendors, and production workflows.
* Experience with purchasing, vendor coordination, scheduling, and production logistics.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects with changing priorities.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently within assigned responsibilities while collaborating closely with project and fabrication teams.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace; Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
* Comfortable working between an office environment and an active fabrication shop.

You don't need to be a fabricator, but you should understand how physical projects move from design and sourcing through fabrication, delivery, and installation.

**Why Join SCPS?**

At SCPS, you'll be part of a creative, collaborative environment where ideas become tangible experiences.

Our projects span different industries, materials, and technical challenges, offering opportunities to expand your knowledge and work alongside talented designers, fabricators, and production professionals.

You'll have meaningful responsibility, contribute directly to project success, and see the results of your work come to life.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $28–$38 per hour, depending on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Full-time, nonexempt position with overtime paid in accordance with applicable law.
* Monday–Friday, onsite at our Torrance, California facility.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your experience supporting fabrication, scenic, experiential, or other physical production projects.

We'd especially like to hear about a project where you helped coordinate materials, schedules, vendors, or production logistics to meet a challenging deadline.

Pay: $28.00 - $38.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through
* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

**The Company:**

Faraday Future is a California-based technology company focused on the design, engineering, and development of intelligent, connected electric vehicles and related artificial intelligence–enabled technologies.

Founded in 2014, the Company's mission is to disrupt the automotive and technology industries by creating user-centric, technology-first experiences. The Company, together with its controlled subsidiaries, operates across multiple technology-driven areas, including AI electric vehicles, robotics, and its crypto business (AIXC), all under its upgraded Global EAI Industry Bridge Strategy, marking the beginning of a new chapter in AI mobility and Web3 integration. The Company aims to leverage the latest technologies and world's best talent to realize exciting new possibilities across all of these lines. Faraday Future's automotive business exemplifies its vision for luxury, innovation, and performance, while its FX strategy aims to introduce mass production models equipped with state-of-the-art luxury technology derived from the FF brand, targeted towards a broader market with middle-to-low price range offerings. FF is committed to redefining mobility through AI innovation. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent transportation and technology by creating something new, something connected, and something with a true global impact.

**Your Role:**

The Product Marketing Intern will support product marketing initiatives for Faraday Future's robotics-related business and product programs. This role will help translate robotics product features, use cases, and technical capabilities into clear, compelling marketing messages, product selling points, and creative campaign ideas. * **Messaging & Creative Ideation:**

* **AI-Enabled Marketing Support:**  
  Use mainstream Gen AI image and video tools to support marketing ideation, visual exploration, video concepts, and creative development.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Work with product, marketing, and design teams to collect product information, clarify product value, and ensure marketing messages are accurate and aligned with business goals.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* **Education:**  
  Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Product Marketing, Media, Advertising, or a related field is preferred.
* **AI Tool Familiarity:**  
  Familiar with mainstream Gen AI image and video tools, such as Grok, Midjourney, Sora, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Veo, or similar platforms.
* **Passion & Interest:**  
  Strong interest in robotics, AI, intelligent mobility, EVs, consumer technology, and product marketing.

  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn product information into clear and compelling marketing language.

The Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) is a campus-wide multidisciplinary matrix organization whose goal is to promote and enhance cancer- relevant research and patient care at UC Irvine. The CFCCC provides research resources to its 250+ faculty and clinician members and offers multidisciplinary cancer care to its patients.

  
Responsibilities:

Uses skills as a seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of analytical practices, policies and procedures; researches, analyzes and develops solutions to a wide range of issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Primarily deals with policies, programs and proposals which are complex in nature and diverse in scope. Develops new programs, policies or procedures for possible implementation.
  
  
The Coordinator reports to the Manager, Cancer Research and Training and supports a portfolio of programs and activities at the UCI Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) that advance cancer research and training initiatives. The Coordinator assists with the implementation, coordination, administration, tracking, monitoring and evaluation of education, training, and research support programs aligned with Cancer Center priorities. This includes the following:
  
  
Training and Education
  

* Coordinate and administer education, training and workforce development portfolio across the cancer career continuum (from high school to faculty levels) spanning basic, translational, clinical and population science.
* Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of cancer- focused education and training initiatives, including experiential summer training programs for high school students, undergraduate research training, faculty leadership and mentorship development programs, and educational activities such as journal clubs, seminars, symposia, lectures and workshops.
* Collect and organize program information to support identification of gaps in the training pathway and coordinate new initiatives to address these gaps
* Coordinate and support education and training activities across the Cancer Center, to ensure integration with the three Research Programs, eight Shared Resource units, the Community Outreach and Engagement Office and the Sue & Ralph Stern Center for Cancer Clinical Trials & Research.
* Engage faculty, trainees and institutional partners to expand participation and strengthen interdisciplinary training opportunities.
* Assist in ensuring education, training and workforce development activities align with Cancer Center strategic priorities, NIH expectations, and NCI Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) requirements.

  
  
Research Oversight and Support
  

* Provide administration and operations for programs and initiatives that support cancer research activities, support services, research development, training grants and collaborative funding opportunities.
* Assist with coordination of cancer-focused training and research funding mechanisms, including T32 programs, R25 initiatives, ACS-IRG, ACS-DICR and related research support services.
* Support logistics and coordination for the development of programs and resources that support research activities, support services, and collaborative and multidisciplinary cancer research funding proposals.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for activities that strengthen research and grant competitiveness, including pilot support, mentoring structures, proposal development efforts and coordination with institutional research development service units.
* Track and monitor program performance, funding outcomes and alignment with Cancer Center research priorities.

  
Program Evaluation, Tracking and Outcomes Monitoring
  

* Assist in maintaining systems to monitor participation, outcomes and program impact across research and training initiatives.
* Coordinate data collection and documentation to support tracking and monitoring of trainee progression across the cancer career pipeline, including academic advancement, publications, funding success and career placement.
* Track, monitor and organize program metrics to inform program improvement and decision-making.
* Assist in preparation of reports, summaries and documentation for leadership, university units (e.g., Office of Research, School of Medicine, etc.), advisory committees and external funding agencies, including materials supporting NCI CCSG and training grant reporting requirements.

  
These are mandatory components of the National Cancer Institute (NCI) P30 Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) and are vital to NCI’s continued designation to the CFCCC. The NCI designation has a vital reputational and financial impact for CFCCC, UCI and UCI Health. Adherence to the guidelines of the CCSG is mandatory and involves ongoing monitoring of the organization for structure, direction, and fiscal management. All decisions at the CFCCC are taken within the context of the CCSG requirements.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across UC Irvine and the Health System with leadership, faculty, staff and students.
* Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **THE COMPANY**

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone's manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, and deployment hubs in Europe and the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

### **THE POSITION**

Saildrone is seeking a Logistics Coordinator for our headquarters in Alameda, CA. In this position, you will develop and execute solutions to ship materials and move material into the field to allow drones to be ready to perform their required missions. The ideal candidate will be motivated by the nuance and complexity of international logistics and by providing support to enable field teams to deliver to Saildrone's customers. You'll be asked to move materials on a moment's notice, while seeking opportunities to reduce cost and ensure Saildrone's operations are compliant with regulatory and customs requirements.

### **THE TEAM**

The Fleet Operations team provides on-site support for assembly and service workflows for the Saildrone vehicle fleet to ensure all assets are fully mission-capable and optimized for maximum operational uptime. The team partners with Engineering, Production, and Operations to bridge design and deployment, accelerate product iteration, and deliver resilient systems that support national security, maritime intelligence, and science exploration missions.

### **THE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for executing shipping and global cargo logistics, coordinating timing, documentation, and internal communications.
* Communicate with cargo forwarders, customs agents, and trucking companies to ensure timely pick-up and deliveries worldwide.
* Prepare documentation for customs clearance, including commercial invoices, carnets, and bills of lading.
* Maintain parts and materials inventory at the forward operating location to ensure adequate spares are on hand as needed for the timely repair of assets.
* Manage shipment process and performance to support global missions.
* Serve as in-house coordinator to efficiently address and expedite domestic & international shipping and critical logistical needs of the business.

### **THE QUALIFICATIONS**

* Prior experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or related field is relevant.
* Knowledge of Air, Ocean, FTL and LTL logistics.
* At least two years executing complex international logistics with an understanding of procedures required for the movement of cargo.
* Demonstrated understanding of modes of transport and documentation requirements for domestic and international shipping.
* Familiarity with small package shipping, via UPS, Fedex, and other commercial carriers.
* Organized and self-driven, capable of working independently with little direction.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Experience with Netsuite and/or comparable ERP and Logistics applications.
* Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when needed to address critical movements.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of role-relevant experience.

### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* **Physical Strength & Agility:** Ability to lift/move up to 30 lbs. and maintain physical activity (bending, kneeling, standing) throughout a full shift.
* **Manual Precision:** High manual dexterity and visual acuity for the safe operation of power tools and precision assembly and repairs.
* **Environmental Adaptability:** Comfortable working in challenging settings, including confined spaces, heights, and working outdoors in variable weather conditions including high heat, cold, and wind.
* **Safety & PPE:** Ability to work around industrial materials and sites while strictly adhering to PPE requirements, including respirators and eye/ear protection as needed.

**Travel: Must be willing and able to travel domestically and internationally up to 25% of the time, which includes renting and operating motor vehicles.**

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

### **BENEFITS**

At Saildrone, we're building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team's well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

* **Generous Time Off:** Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual plus a robust annual holiday schedule and paid sick leave ensure you can rest, reset, and sustain performance over time.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Premium, multi-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with significant company contributions for employees and dependents—providing security and peace of mind.
* **Shared Ownership in the Mission:** Equity grants are a core part of our compensation, allowing you to participate in the long-term value you help create through meaningful, operational work.
* **Retirement Savings:** Access to a 401(k) retirement plan with flexible pre-tax and Roth payroll contribution options supports long-term financial planning.
* **Investment in Your Growth:** We support your continuous learning through an annual professional development reimbursement prog

jobs.description:
**About Treeswift**

In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.

We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.

Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.

To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.

We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.

Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**The Position:**

Treeswift is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to support our hiring efforts as we continue to grow. You'll work closely with our recruiting team and hiring managers to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communication, and keep our recruiting processes organized and running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who is exceptionally detail-oriented, communicates well, and has experience working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment. You'll own the day-to-day coordination of our hiring process while helping identify opportunities to improve how we work.

This is a good fit for someone who enjoys the operational side of recruiting, cares about the candidate experience, and wants to have a hand in building processes as the company scales.  
  
You will be a key member of the Recruiting team which sits as part of the People Operations organization.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own interview scheduling and coordination across multiple roles and hiring teams, including virtual and in-person interviews.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, ensuring timely communication and a positive experience.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to manage competing priorities, anticipate scheduling needs, and keep searches moving forward.
* Coordinate interview logistics, ensuring candidates and interviewers are prepared and have the information they need.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows and help build more efficient processes as we scale.
* Build and maintain recruiting processes, documentation, templates, and resources.
* Support day-to-day recruiting operations in Ashby (our ATS), including managing job postings, maintaining accurate candidate records, coordinating offers, and keeping hiring workflows up to date.
* Help strengthen our candidate experience and employer brand through thoughtful, consistent communication.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and internal stakeholders to support a smooth hiring process.
* Support sourcing efforts as needed, including candidate outreach and pipeline management.
* Help the recruiting team stay organized and adapt as hiring priorities shift.
* Proactively flag issues, suggest improvements, and take ownership of resolving them.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* You have 1–3+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, sourcing, or people operations at an early-stage or high-growth company.
* You're exceptionally organized and detail-oriented. You catch the small things, keep track of moving pieces, and take pride in getting things right.
* You're a strong communicator. You know how to work with different stakeholders, keep people informed, and build good relationships across a team.
* You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change and processes aren't always fully built out.
* You look for ways to make things better. You're not afraid to suggest a new approach or take ownership of improving an existing process.
* You care about candidate experience and understand the importance of representing the company well throughout the hiring process.
* You're proactive and reliable. When you own something, people can count on you to follow through.
* You're comfortable working in an ATS and understand the importance of maintaining accurate recruiting data.
* You're based in NYC and comfortable being in the office regularly.

**What We Value:**
------------------

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity**. We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.

**Ownership mindset**. If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* Life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents
* Flexible, unlimited paid time off
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Free OneMedical membership
* Commuter benefits
* Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues.

The estimated salary range for this position is $45–$60 USD per hour. Total

AARP Services, Inc., founded in 1999, is a wholly-owned taxable subsidiary of AARP. AARP Services manages the provider relationships for and performs quality control oversight of the wide range of products and services that carry the AARP name and are made available by independent providers as benefits to AARP’s millions of members. The provider offers currently span health products, financial products, travel and leisure products, and life event services. Specific products include Medicare supplemental insurance; credit cards, auto and home, mobile home and motorcycle insurance, life insurance and annuities; member discounts on rental cars, cruises, vacation packages and lodging; special offers on technology and gifts; pharmacy services and legal services. AARP Services also engages in new product development activities for AARP and provides certain consulting services to outside companies.

The **Sales Account Manager** identifies, develops, and manages new business opportunities while building strong, long-term client relationships. This role manages prospecting and sales activities, develops compelling client presentations and proposals, and partners cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Research to create integrated media and marketing solutions that address client needs. The Sales Account Manager stays current on evolving media trends and identifies opportunities to enhance sales effectiveness, improve processes, and drive business growth.

  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Manages client activity by tracking sales activities, managing contact information, and maintaining strong relationships.
* Prospects for new clients based on territory assignment/category/or other opportunities identified by sales management.
* Develops presentations and media plans, in collaboration with marketing and research teams, to meet client needs.
* Embraces new media channels and products to stay up to date with market trends and recommends products and programs to clients.
* Prepares monthly and annual territory reports or other sales activity information as needed.
* Maintains all sales activity in a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool or the best available technology.
* Manages client interactions through email, phone, in-person meetings/presentations, and both virtual and in-person entertainment.

  
**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) preferred in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in media sales, advertising sales, account management, business development, or a related client-facing sales role.
* Demonstrated experience prospecting, developing new business, growing existing business, and managing a portfolio of client accounts, with a proven ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Strong knowledge of the media and advertising landscape, including digital, print, social, content, and emerging media channels, with the ability to recommend solutions aligned with client objectives.
* Experience developing and delivering client presentations, proposals, and integrated marketing solutions in partnership with marketing, research, creative, and other cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and needs assessment through proposal development, negotiation, closing, and ongoing account management.
* Experience using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms such as Salesforce to manage prospects, maintain client information, track sales activity, and support pipeline and territory reporting.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and internal stakeholders through virtual meetings, in-person presentations, email, phone, and client events.

*AARP will not sponsor an employment visa for this position.*  
  
**Additional Requirements**

  

* Regular and reliable job attendance
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Exhibit respect and understanding of others to maintain professional relationships
* Independent judgement in evaluation options to make sound decisions
* Home office environment with the ability to work effectively surrounded by moderate home environment noise - (Telework)

**Compensation and Benefits**  
  
AARP offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including a 401(k); 100% company-funded pension plan; health, dental, and vision plans; life insurance; paid time off to include company and individual holidays, vacation, sick, caregiving, and parental leave; performance-based and peer-based recognition and tuition reimbursement.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
  
AARP is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. AARP does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or on any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**

**Hybrid -** Midtown West, New York (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)  
*(The office is less than a 10-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square.)*

**SHAPE THE FUTURE OF PRIVACY WITH USERCENTRICS**

Usercentrics is a global leader in the field of consent management platforms (CMP). We follow our company vision to build a world where user privacy enables a thriving digital ecosystem. Our mission is to provide privacy solutions that empower organizations to embrace data privacy while building trust with their users through freedom of choice. With our product, businesses can collect, manage and document user consents on websites and apps, and achieve full compliance in accordance with global privacy regulations while facilitating high consent rates and building trust with their customers.

Usercentrics is seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Enterprise Accounts, you will manage a high-value portfolio of strategic customers across the US and Americas using the Usercentrics product suite. You will ensure customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive long-term success. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through best practices, coordinating across internal teams, and developing customized success plans to maximize their ROI. Your main focus is driving growth and the customer journey in the Americas market.

**Your Tasks**

Strategic Customer Success & Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for high-value premium/corporate customers in the US and Americas, building strong relationships with key stakeholders (Privacy, Legal, Marketing/AdTech, Security, IT).
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business goals, regional compliance needs (e.g., CCPA/CPRA and other US state laws, PIPEDA/Quebec Law 25, LGPD), and success metrics.
* Conduct regular business reviews to align customer objectives with platform capabilities.
* Act as a customer advocate, communicating feedback to Product, Support, and Sales.

Customer Success Planning & Execution

* Provide personal onboarding support and implementation consultation (with Customer Engineer support).
* Develop and implement Customer Success Plans (CSPs) for each enterprise account, outlining goals, milestones, and success metrics.
* Proactively monitor customer health, engagement, and risks, acting to prevent churn.
* Guide customers through product adoption, best practices, and ongoing optimization.

Upsell & Expansion Strategy

* Identify upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities based on customer needs and business challenges.
* Work with Product, Marketing, and CE teams to position upgrades, add-ons, and expanded use cases.
* Lead commercial discussions on renewals and expansion, ensuring mutual benefit.
* Obtain customer referrals, case studies, and testimonials.

Internal Coordination & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Product, Support, Direct Sales, and Customer Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Act as the customer's voice internally, influencing product development and feature prioritization for the Americas market.
* Collaborate with Marketing to share US and Americas customer success stories.

Industry Expertise & Thought Leadership

* Stay current on evolving US state and Americas privacy regulations, and on standards such as the IAB Global Privacy Platform (GPP) and Global Privacy Control (GPC).
* Stay up to date with product features.
* Educate customers on CMP, including new features, products, and add-ons.

  
**Requirements**  

* 3+ years in Customer Success or a related role, preferably in SaaS, data privacy, or compliance technology, with familiarity with US state privacy laws, PIPEDA, and LGPD.
* Ability to develop and execute customer success plans for enterprise clients.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset to identify challenges and propose solutions.
* Ability to recognize and act on upsell and expansion opportunities.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support.
Able to work US/Americas time zones; occasional travel to customer sites and events.  

  
  
**Benefits**

**BENEFITS INCLUDE**

* Hybrid workplace

The annual base salary range for this position is outlined below. Compensation within this range is determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, role-specific skills, relevant experience, and internal equity.

At Usercentrics, we are committed to transparent and equitable compensation practices.

*Base Salary: $85,000 - $100,000*

*OTE: $100,000 - $125,000*  
  
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

### **Why join Usercentrics?**

jobs.title: PEO Customer Success Specialist, Broker Partners
jobs.description:
**About Niural**
----------------

Niural is a modern global payroll platform that offers US Payroll, US PEO, Global EOR, Global Payroll, and Global Contractor management in a single unified platform powered by AI. Our next gen HR and payroll platform provides a net new experience for small to large clients with its own payroll tax engine and modern payment rails. We are committed to redefining how companies operate in a new era of AI, creating truly global solutions that empower businesses to thrive in the digital economy. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth oriented work environment.

**Overview**
------------

We are seeking a detail oriented and customer focused PEO Customer Success Specialist with at least 2 years of experience to serve as the primary contact for PEO clients who come to Niural through our broker partners. This role is dedicated to our broker partner book and bridges payroll and benefits with exceptional customer service, ensuring client satisfaction, timely issue resolution, and smooth communication between clients, their brokers, and internal teams. CPP or FPC certification preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the main point of contact for PEO clients serviced through broker partners, providing exceptional customer service and support
* Build and maintain strong relationships with both clients and their brokers
* Coordinate with brokers on client needs, escalations, renewals, and open enrollment, keeping them informed while respecting the client relationship
* Respond to and resolve client and broker inquiries related to payroll, taxes, and benefits in a timely and professional manner
* Assist client employees with payroll and benefits related questions, including eligibility, enrollment, and qualifying life event changes
* Review benefit deductions on payroll for accuracy and work with the benefits team to resolve discrepancies
* Collaborate closely with internal teams (such as payroll operations, benefits, implementation, engineering, and sales) to investigate and resolve client issues efficiently

* Suggest workflow improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and the client and broker experience. Work with engineering to provide feedback on client pain points and product improvements
* Monitor payroll deadlines
* Review and audit payroll data for accuracy
* Audit monthly client payroll invoices
* Help build and maintain internal knowledge bases, FAQs, or client and broker resources

**About You**
-------------

You'll thrive in this role if:

* You're detail oriented with strong organizational skills
* You provide high quality customer service and build strong relationships with clients and brokers
* You understand how the broker relationship works and how to balance client and broker expectations
* You can confidently explain benefits concepts to clients and employees
* You communicate clearly and professionally across teams, with clients, and with brokers
* You proactively identify issues and collaborate to resolve them

**Requirements**
----------------

* At least 2 years of PEO payroll experience
* Experience supporting clients sold or serviced through benefits brokers or a PEO broker channel
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, tax compliance, and benefits administration
* Working knowledge of employee benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, FSA, HSA, 401(k), and COBRA
* Understanding of open enrollment, eligibility rules, qualifying life events, and pretax versus post tax deductions
* Experience handling client and broker inquiries related to payroll and benefits
* CPP or FPC certification preferred
* Experience with US and Canada payroll processing preferred
* Ability to audit payroll data with strong attention to detail

**Compensation**
----------------

$60K to $80K

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Oath**

Oath is the strategic giving platform designed to help donors maximize the impact of their contributions by guiding them to the races and causes where their dollars can make the greatest impact. Oath has directed over $150M while protecting donors' data and avoiding the spam and spin of other giving platforms. As the one stop shop for a generation of donors who want to make a difference, Oath is building the future of philanthropy.

### **The Opportunity**

You'll run the channels that bring new grassroots donors into Oath and turn existing donors into recruiters. Your mission is to grow Oath's donor base through paid media and peer-to-peer programs while building a community of donors who share Oath with their networks. The role is about 70% paid media and peer-to-peer marketing and 30% community building. You'll own budgets, test fast, and report what works, with the 2028 presidential cycle as the biggest acquisition moment in Oath's history. You'll have the autonomy to build these programs your way, with the support of the Head of Growth and a team across email, social, and creator partnerships.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the donor journey**: Own the experience from first impression to sign-up, including what donors see in ads and how they experience Oath at every step after.
* **Own paid media**: Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google, and emerging platforms. Own budget allocation, targeting, creative testing, pacing, forecasting, and cost-per-donor goals. Set a specific strategy for each funnel stage, build new audiences to reach new donor archetypes, and plan around reach, saturation, and the cost to acquire a new donor, not just ROAS.
* **Build community, ambassadors, and the peer-to-peer program**: Manage Oath’s community spaces and give donors who want to do more a clear way to get involved. Find, train, and support the volunteer ambassadors and creators who bring new donors to Oath. Launch and run donor-to-donor texting, referral campaigns, giving circles, and shareable race pages that turn donors into bundlers.
* **Write, test, and optimize**: Draft and iterate ad copy, landing pages, and P2P scripts in Oath’s voice: direct, data-grounded, and never alarmist. Work with engineering and product to design landing page tests, run structured A/B tests, and drive conversion rate optimization. Get excited about building and optimizing routines with AI tools.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Work closely with Email & Lifecycle, Social & Creator Partnerships, and Partnerships so every channel tells one story. Be comfortable in HubSpot and collaborate with lifecycle marketing on CRM.
* **Time campaigns and support earned media**: Plan pushes around major national cultural and political events, and help broaden our reach through earned media, exploring new efforts and tracking the results.
* **Report, measure, and iterate**: Own weekly reporting on spend, cost per donor, conversion, and retention by channel, with a clear story of what moved and why. Own measurement across the full top-of-funnel team (community, influencer and affiliate, events), and build a scorecard leadership can trust. Understand our economics well enough to shift budget to what performs.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Strong background**: You have 3+ years in any of the following: paid digital, performance marketing, or digital fundraising (ideally for political, advocacy, or nonprofit organizations); growth roles at leading tech or consumer companies; MBB consulting; investment banking; or VC/PE. Your background signals exceptional caliber.
* **High ba**r: You hold yourself accountable for both quality and results, and you’re comfortable pushing beyond the obvious idea.
* **Hands-on operator**: You have a proven track record managing paid budgets with strong ROI, and you’re data-literate: you can read dashboards, interpret metrics, and turn data into decisions. Hands-on experience with peer-to-peer texting or relational organizing tools is a plus, and so is experience building or moderating online communities.
* **Strong writer**: You’re comfortable drafting and testing creative in a set brand voice.
* **Thinker and doer**: You have a bias toward action, like being scrappy and creative, and connect the dots across the org. No task is too small or too big.
* **Mission-driven and winning mindset**: You’re excited about politics & civic engagement and you get excited about every new donor we reach
* **Management experience**: Have management experience or are open to managing interns!

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Base Salary: $100,000-$125,000
* Equity package
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k) matching
* Time Off: Flexible PTO
* Office: 3 days per week in our NYC headquarters; flexible remote work for the other 2 days

We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Edelman is looking for an account executive level Social Media Manager to join a growing team of community experts that develop, execute, and support social media strategies on behalf of our clients.

  

As a Social Media Manager, you will be the brand’s eyes, ears, and tone of voice on social. You will engage and nurture communities across multiple social channels through relevant content and meaningful interactions.

You have a nose for real-time, culturally relevant opportunities and social trends and will bring social-first, community-led thinking to brainstorms and content ideation. You will be flexible and agile, and able to work collaboratively with all teams to ensure that the brand’s communication objectives and strategies are met.

* Exemplify the brand voice and tone in all community interactions.

Stay up to date on emerging creators, trends and formats, and platform updates.  

  

Qualifications:

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Operations Coordinator | Kirsten Jordan Team (KJT) at The Corcoran Group**

**Location:** New York City · Full-time

**Reports to:** Head of Marketing and Brand

**Hours:** 9AM–6PM ET, Monday–Friday; occasional evenings/weekends around launches and events

**Compensation:** $50,000-$60,000

**THE ROLE**

As Operations Coordinator for the Kirsten Jordan Team, you'll work alongside experienced agents, marketing professionals, and transaction specialists, gaining hands-on exposure to every stage of the sales process, from listing preparation and marketing launches to negotiations, contract execution, and closings. You'll have a front-row seat to both the resale and new development businesses while learning how a top-performing team operates at the highest level.

This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who aspires to become a successful New York City real estate agent. Through daily involvement in the team's operations, you'll develop the market knowledge, client service skills, transaction expertise, and professional network that form the foundation of a thriving career at Corcoran.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ambitious professional who enjoys being at the center of a fast-paced business, takes pride in supporting others, and is motivated by the opportunity to learn from some of the best in the industry.

 **Compensation:**

$50,000 - $60,000

 **Responsibilities:**

**WHAT YOU’LL BE ACCOUNTABLE FOR**

* **Listings.** Every listing is launch-ready and accurate, with documents gathered, vendor shoots scheduled, and pricing, status, and open houses correct across CTE, StreetEasy, Corcoran, and our website.
* **Transactions.** Deals stay on track from offer to closing. You work with LC/TC on paperwork and board packages, keep deadlines visible, and let marketing know about key milestones (price changes, In Contract, Sold).
* **Agent support.** Agents have one reliable go-to for scheduling, property information, offer tracking, and pitch and pricing materials.
* **Marketing logistics.** Marketing runs without chasing details. You handle vendor scheduling, print and mail production, event logistics, and organized asset folders, and you supply up-to-date listing performance data.
* **Team systems.** The team calendar, trackers, meetings, expenses, and new-hire setup are current and easy for everyone to use.
* *This is a coordination role. Marketing strategy, vendor and budget decisions, and people management sit with others on the team.*

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Listings and deals are organized, accurate, and on schedule. Agents always know where things stand, and marketing gets what it needs without asking twice.

* **30 days:** Up to speed on KJT and Corcoran systems; calendars, listing folders, and trackers are current.
* **60 days:** Core listing, vendor, and production workflows run reliably with little prompting.
* **90 days:** You own day-to-day coordination end-to-end, and the team relies on you as its operational backbone.

 **Qualifications:**

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 1–3 years of experience in real estate coordination, mortgage origination, sales support, operations, or a similar role.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with dependable follow-through on many moving pieces at once.
* A clear communicator who is comfortable working with agents, clients, Corcoran departments, and vendors.
* At ease with digital tools and happy to be hands-on, whether that’s updating a tracker or running a delivery.
* Discreet with confidential client information. Familiarity with NYC real estate systems (CTE, REBNY RLS, StreetEasy) is a plus.

 **About Company**

The Kirsten Jordan Team is one of Manhattan's top-producing luxury real estate teams, representing some of New York City's most notable resale and new development properties. This role is designed for someone who is eager to build a long-term career in real estate and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business from the ground up.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About DataCamp**

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 19 million learners and 6,000+ companies, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

### **About the Role:**

The Sales Development Representative's (SDR's) main focus is engaging with new prospective customers via outbound activities (email, phone calls, LinkedIn), shining a light on potential challenges they're facing or goals they're trying to address and determining whether DataCamp's solutions can address those needs. Success in this role is highly dependent on your ability to initiate conversations and network from the ground up, the ability to consistently and enthusiastically complete your day to day activities, applying critical thinking in every situation, and your professional persistence.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Generate interest with your prospects by leveraging all outreach channels: phone calls, email, and LinkedIn
* Work independently and with Account Executives to build your territory account list on a weekly basis via outbound prospecting tools like ZoomInfo, LeadIQ, and Sales Navigator
* Qualify leads with intent, curiosity, respect and a high level of urgency

**Job Summary**

As an Outbound Logistics Coordinator, you’ll keep products moving from warehouse to customer by coordinating orders, inventory, carriers, and shipment documentation. You’ll work across warehouse, purchasing, planning, and customer service teams to resolve issues and support reliable, compliant order fulfillment.

**Responsibilities**

Your impact: Accurate coordination helps customers receive complete orders on time while giving warehouse and supply chain teams clearer information to act on.

**Experience**

* Experience in logistics, supply chain management, warehouse management, warehouse distribution, or a supply chain operations role; familiarity with warehouse experience and order fulfillment is valuable.

**Property Overview:**

The **Rangel campus** is a diverse residential community comprising of 984 units spread across 8 buildings, all of which are fourteen-story high-rise elevator buildings, each equipped with two elevators. A day-care, senior center, community center and storage are attached to Building 8. Building 6 contains one community 5,502 sq ft community space that is currently vacant. The property also includes 226 surface parking spaces, one outdoor refuse collection area, three children's play areas, and open paved and landscaped spaces. Four commercial spaces are also attached to one of the high-rise buildings. This site will be undergoing substantial rehabilitation under the NYCHA PACT Program including renovations to the grounds, substantial elevator rehabilitation, and each individual apartment receiving full remediation and renovation.

***Role and Responsibilities Overview***

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Community Manager supports the Community Manager in daily property operations and is prepared to manage the property in the Community Manager's absence. This role focuses on leasing support, resident services, and administrative and financial accuracy at the property level.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Property Operations Support**

* Assist the Community Manager with day-to-day operations, leasing, and resident relations
* Assist with move-in/move-out processing and unit turnover coordination
* Assist with property inspections and coordination of vendor and maintenance work
* Manage the property in the Community Manager's absence, including staff direction and issue resolution

**Financial & Administrative Support**

* Support rent collection, delinquency follow-up, and resident ledger accuracy
* Assist with preparation of financial and operational reports
* Maintain accurate resident files and administrative records

**Compliance Support**

* Support compliance documentation and recertification processes in partnership with the Compliance department
* Assist in maintaining audit-ready resident files

**Resident Relations**

* Respond to resident inquiries and service requests, escalating as needed
* Support resident engagement activities and communications
* Assist in resolving resident concerns professionally and promptly

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma required; some college coursework preferred
* 1-2 years of property management or related administrative experience
* Strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills
* Familiarity with property management software preferred
* Ability to work occasional evenings/weekends as needed

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Property administration and recordkeeping
* Resident service and communication
* Basic financial/ledger accuracy
* Time management and multi-tasking

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

No direct reports; this position does not carry standing supervisory responsibility, but may direct leasing or administrative staff when managing the property in the Community Manager's absence.

jobs.description:
#### **Design Event Coordinator - Bold Catering & Design**

**For the detail-obsessed, solution-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of person.**

There is something pretty incredible about watching an event come to life. The transformation of a space. The energy of a team working toward a shared vision. The moment when months of planning turn into an unforgettable experience.

But behind every extraordinary event is someone making sure every detail comes together.

**That's where you come in.**

We're looking for an **Event Coordinator** who thrives on the excitement, creativity, and occasional chaos of bringing exceptional events to life. Someone who can build a flawless timeline, anticipate a challenge before it becomes a problem, and jump into the action when the moment calls for it.

This isn't a behind-the-desk kind of role. You'll be involved in every stage of execution, from coordinating the moving pieces before an event to being on-site when it all comes together. You'll work alongside talented designers, floral teams, installation crews, and vendors to turn creative visions into remarkable experiences.

If you're energized by a fast-moving environment, take personal pride in delivering exceptional results, and believe no task is beneath you when it comes to getting the job done, we'd love to meet you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own the details.** Take the lead on event logistics, timelines, layouts, vendor coordination, and all the moving pieces that make an event successful.
* **Bring the vision to life.** Partner with design, floral, and installation teams to translate creative concepts into beautifully executed events.
* **Be the go-to person.** Build strong relationships with clients and vendors, communicate proactively, and ensure everyone feels confident and informed.
* **Make things happen.** Coordinate everything from venue walkthroughs and rental orders to staffing needs, special requests, and event-day logistics.
* **Be where the action is.** Show up on-site, oversee setup, guide teams, troubleshoot challenges, and lend a hand wherever it's needed.
* **Think three steps ahead.** Anticipate obstacles, adapt when plans change, and find solutions that keep the event moving forward.
* **Keep an eye on the numbers.** Track expenses, manage purchases, reconcile event costs, and help ensure each event is as financially successful as it is memorable.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* **You're a doer.** You don't wait to be asked, and you're just as comfortable jumping into setup as you are managing a detailed production schedule.
* **You take ownership.** You follow through, hold yourself accountable, and care deeply about the quality of your work.
* **You thrive under pressure.** Tight timelines, competing priorities, and last-minute changes bring out your resourcefulness.
* **You're relentlessly organized.** Details matter to you, and you have the systems and discipline to keep multiple events moving simultaneously.
* **You're a natural collaborator.** You communicate clearly, build trust, and understand that great events require everyone working together.
* **You're flexible and adaptable.** You understand that the event calendar doesn't always follow a traditional workweek, and you're ready to be there when it matters.
* **You genuinely love hospitality.** Creating memorable experiences and exceeding expectations is what motivates you.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience coordinating events, managing logistics, or working in event production or a related field.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with vendors, managing budgets, and coordinating multiple priorities.
* Comfort using Microsoft Office and event management platforms; experience with Caterease, NOWSTA, Social Tables, or similar systems is a plus.
* Availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedules.
* Ability to be active on-site for extended periods and assist with event setup and breakdown, including lifting up to 50 pounds.

**Ready to Make It Happen?**
----------------------------

The most rewarding events don't happen by accident. They happen because passionate, talented people care enough to get every detail right.

If you're someone who finds satisfaction in a job well done, brings positive energy to a challenge, and loves being part of the team that makes the magic happen, **we want you on ours.**

**Apply today and help us create experiences worth remembering.**

Position Description: Customer Account Manager (CAM)

Job Description

The Customer Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and represents their needs throughout the organization. This role builds lasting relationships and coordinates the internal activities required to deliver responsive, accurate service for technically engineered systems, from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment and post-delivery support.

Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Production Planning, Purchasing, Quality, Logistics, and Finance, the Customer Account Manager translates customer requests into clear actions of supporting teams, establishes ownership and timelines, and follows through to resolution. Success requires technical aptitude, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across departments while keeping customers informed.

Key Responsibilities

* Customer relationships: Develop a thorough understanding of assigned accounts, their applications, business priorities, and service expectations. Maintain regular communication, build trust, and serve as the central contact for day-to-day requests and escalations.
* Cross-functional coordination: Translate customer needs into documented requirements, deliverables, owners, and due dates. Coordinate internal follow-up, resolve handoff gaps, and escalate competing priorities or overdue actions to the appropriate leaders.
* Records and improvement: Maintain accurate customer, quotation, order, and issue records in CRM and ERP systems. Share recurring customer feedback and recommend improvements to communication, service, and internal workflows.

Qualifications

* Experience in customer account management, technical customer service, inside sales, project coordination, or a similar role supporting business customers in manufacturing or an engineered-product environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, open orders, and requests with different priorities and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information, communicate delays, and handle difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using CRM, ERP, or order management systems.
* Experience supporting distributors, contractors, OEMs, or other commercial and industrial customers.

Measures of Success

* Timely acknowledgment, tracking, and resolution of customer requests, with clear ownership of open actions.
* Effective coordination of customer issues through corrective action and confirmed closure.
* Strong customer satisfaction and retention, with support for repeat business and account growth.

jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Account Executive in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Benefits: Dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, mileage reimbursement, paid time off, vision insurance

Schedule: Monday to Friday; weekend availability as needed

Supplemental Pay: Commission pay, bonus pay

Ability to commute/relocate: Atlanta, GA

Experience: Route sales or territory sales: 1 year (Required); Account management: 1 year (Preferred); B2B sales or staffing industry: 1 year (Preferred)

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

**POSITION TITLE:** Community Manager

**DEPARTMENT:** Resident Services

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Manager

**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt

**JOB SUMMARY:**The Community Manager is a business leader who focuses on resident customer service and manages operations, leasing activity, renewals, collections, financial reporting, supplies, and communications for an assigned residential community.

**VALUES MODELED:** All employees are expected to find ways to bring our values to life every day by demonstrating: leadership, commitment, and integrity.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:** Resident feedback on quality and timeliness of resident services provided; resident turnover.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Manage day-to-day leasing operations.**
  + Inspect community on a regular basis and verifies the condition of vacant units in order to minimize rental arrears.
  + Manage daily community requirements and maintains long-range capital improvements planning.
  + Ensure all monies received are deposited and recorded on a daily basis and confirms proper bookkeeping procedures are followed.
  + Compile weekly/monthly community status reports.
  + Promptly respond to resident concerns, comments, and/or complaints.
  + Ensure that the proper move-in paperwork, keys, and remotes are prepared for a new resident.
  + Operate the office in a professional, clean, uncluttered, and well-staffed manner.
  + Inspect make-ready apartments prior to move in.
  + Enforce occupancy policies and procedures.
  + Maintain and/or create a resident renewal program to encourage resident retention.
  + Create a sense of community at the community while maintaining the policy of non-fraternization.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.
* **Manage community maintenance with the assistance of the service team.**
  + Organize incoming and outgoing inspections and prepare inspection reports.
  + Implement preventive maintenance programs.
  + Oversee improvement projects.
  + Manage requests for repairs and maintenance and evaluates timely completion of work orders.
  + Maintain compliance with required permits for operating the community, such as, pool, elevator, etc.
  + Monitor electric, water, and gas usage on the community.
* **Maintains and manages all financial responsibilities.**
  + Approve and submit invoices for payment in a timely manner.
  + Maintain accurate records of community transactions and submits on timely basis (i.e., rent rolls, delinquency reports, move-in/move-outs, etc.).
  + Complete variance reports and other weekly reports.
  + Prepare annual budgets. Keep accurate and updated financial reports.

* **Manages and monitors rental collection.**
  + Ensure rent and other charges are collected timely and posted daily.
  + Ensure the proper legal notices are given and deadlines met concerning filing eviction, filing writs, and attending court hearings.
  + Ensure compliance with community policies and lease agreements. Responds to violations and communicates with the residents.
  + Assess move-out condition of apartments and has a final account statement sent with the final disposition.
  + Immediately inform and refer any liability claims, legal complaints, or other violations to the Regional Manager and/or corporate office.
* **Manages community personnel.**
  + Hire, train, and evaluate community staff.

Our team is our secret sauce — a mix of **hospitality pros, culinary experts, technologists, and innovators** redefining what it means to build **meaningful, stable, and opportunity-filled careers in hospitality.**

* **Creative Freedom:** Everyone contributes ideas and shapes the future of our service.

**What you'll be doing**

* **Lead, train, and develop the front-of-house team,** ensuring exceptional service delivery that aligns with Sifted’s brand values and client expectations

* Monitor and manage spending to ensure **operations remain within the established budget** for the client account
* Prepare **regular reports and performance updates for the client**, highlighting successes, challenges, and opportunities for enhancement

**Build a Career Helping Local Businesses**

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**
